_comment: REAL pilot-region boundary — Landkreis Uckermark, Brandenburg. Extracted from BKG Verwaltungsgebiete 1:25 000 (VG25), layer vg25_krs, AGS 12073, Produktstand 31.12.2025. Source archive pinned and checksummed in ingest/sources.manifest.json (bkg-vg25); see docs/data/sources.md. Licence CC BY 4.0 — attribution is mandatory wherever this reaches a screen or an export: '© BKG (Jahr des letzten Datenbezugs) CC BY 4.0, Datenquellen: https://sgx.geodatenzentrum.de/web_public/gdz/datenquellen/datenquellen_vg25.pdf'. Coordinates are EPSG:25832 (ETRS89 / UTM 32N) — already the storage CRS of ADR-0002, so 02_reproject.sh is a no-op for this file. Rounded to 0.01 m; VG25 is a 1:25 000 product, so further digits would be false precision. Regenerate with ingest/02b_extract_pilot_boundary.sh.
